about.title: IT Consultant Challenge 2026
about.summary: Step into the role of an IT Consultant—from understanding a business problem to building, adapting, and pitching a working product.
intro: The <bold>IT Consultant Challenge</bold> is a team-based competition where participants step into the role of <bold>IT Consultants</bold> to solve real business challenges through responsible digital solutions.

Following two successful seasons in <bold>2024</bold> and <bold>2025</bold>, the challenge returns with a brand-new format and the theme <bold>"Prompt to Production."</bold> As AI continues to transform the way software is built, today's software developers need more than the ability to write code. They need to understand business needs, work effectively with AI, make informed technical decisions, and deliver solutions they can confidently stand behind.

In teams of <bold>up to three</bold>, participants will tackle a case study inspired by a real-life project. Throughout the competition, you'll experience the journey of an IT consultant - from understanding business problems and designing a solution to building a working product, adapting to changing requirements, and presenting your final delivery.

description: The <extrabold>{contestName}</extrabold> is an engaging team-based competition where participants step into the role of IT consultants. In teams of up to three, you are tasked with solving real-life IT problems by developing innovative, digitalized solutions for a client. This challenge simulates the dynamic environment of IT consulting, requiring teams to collaborate, think critically, and deliver impactful solutions that meet client needs.
The event is jointly organized by {netcompanyName} Vietnam and {codeMelyName} - a Tech community for young enthusiasts.

rules.title: Rules
rules.content: Teams select a case study from the challenge provided by the organizers, then analyze and design ideas and solutions to address the identified issues. Prizes will be given to ideas that are feasible, creative, and exemplify strong teamwork.
description: (1) After receiving the problem from the organizers, the teams come up with solutions/case studies to solve the problem posed by the organizers.
(2) For each solution, the teams need to analyze it from both business and technical perspectives. Then, illustrate the solutions with system designs under the guidance of mentors.
(3) After completing the task or when the allotted time is up, the teams submit their work and present their solutions to the organizers.
(4) The organizers evaluate the submissions, and the 3 teams with the most impressive solutions receive awards from the competition.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to common questions before you and your teammates begin the challenge.

items.question: What are the competition rounds?
items.answer: There are three knockout rounds: Discover, Build and Deliver. The Organiser will determine how many teams advance after each round based on the number of participating teams and submission quality.

items.question: How many members are on a team?
items.answer: Each team has up to 3 members who are students or young technology enthusiasts interested in software development and IT consulting.

items.question: Is the competition online or onsite?
items.answer: Discover and Build take place online. The final is onsite at Netcompany Ho Chi Minh City for local teams and online for teams from other locations.

items.question: Can teams use AI tools?
items.answer: Yes. AI should be used as a supporting tool. Teams must validate AI-generated content, assess product feasibility, and take responsibility for their entire submission; presentation slides should not be entirely AI-generated.

items.question: Are there technology-stack restrictions?
items.answer: No. Teams can choose the language, framework and technologies that best suit their solution.
